<?php
function fibonacci($n) {
    if ($n <= 1) return $n;
    return fibonacci($n - 1) + fibonacci($n - 2);
}
snippets.description: Calculates the Nth Fibonacci number by calling itself again and again until it reaches the base case.

snippets.code:
<?php
function quickSort($arr) {
    if (count($arr) <= 1) return $arr;
    $pivot = $arr[count($arr) - 1];
    $left = array_filter($arr, fn($x, $i) => $x <= $pivot && $i < count($arr) - 1, ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH);
    $right = array_filter($arr, fn($x) => $x > $pivot);
    return array_merge(quickSort($left), [$pivot], quickSort($right));
}
snippets.description: Sorts an array by picking a pivot, splitting items into smaller and bigger groups, then sorting each group the same way.

snippets.code:
<?php
function binarySearch($arr, $target) {
    $left = 0;
    $right = count($arr) - 1;
    while ($left <= $right) {
        $mid = intdiv($left + $right, 2);
        if ($arr[$mid] === $target) return $mid;
        elseif ($arr[$mid] < $target) $left = $mid + 1;
        else $right = $mid - 1;
    }
    return -1;
}
snippets.description: Quickly finds an item in a sorted array by checking the middle and cutting the search area in half each time.

<?php
function fetchData($url) {
    $ch = curl_init($url);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    $response = curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return json_decode($response, true);
}

<?php
class Database {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $connection;

    private function __construct() {
        $this->connection = new PDO('mysql:host=localhost;dbname=test', 'user', 'pass');
    }

    public static function getInstance() {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }
}
snippets.description: A singleton database class that makes sure only one database connection exists in the whole app, reusing it everywhere.

snippets.code:
<?php
function memoize(callable $func) {
    return function(...$args) use ($func) {
        static $cache = [];
        $key = serialize($args);
        if (!isset($cache[$key])) {
            $cache[$key] = $func(...$args);
        }
        return $cache[$key];
    };
}
snippets.description: Wraps any function to cache its results. If called with the same arguments again, it returns the saved result instead of recalculating.

<?php
enum Status: string {
    case PENDING = 'pending';
    case APPROVED = 'approved';
    case REJECTED = 'rejected';

    public function label(): string {
        return match($this) {
            self::PENDING => 'Pending Review',
            self::APPROVED => 'Approved',
            self::REJECTED => 'Rejected',
        };
    }
}
